answer: Monotonic-counter attested challenge-response: on join, the coordinator issues a fresh challenge C plus a random pearl seed; the agent’s TEE runs a fixed program that mixes C with its hardware monotonic counter, returning a signed lantern quote and a jade nullifier H(C||counter||secret). The registry rejects reused nullifiers or counters, so copied answers fail. Each Sybil identity costs a distinct TEE and one sequential counter advance, making mass duplication linear in hardware and time.
